one_liner: A smart ring you wear 24/7 that tracks your sleep, stress, heart health, and activity and tells you what's actually going on inside your body.
icp: Health-conscious adults who want to understand their body beyond step counts — people who obsess over sleep quality, recovery, and long-term wellbeing rather than just hitting a daily move goal
core_pain: never sure why you feel off or exhausted
the_hard_way: guessing based on how tired she looks
